from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u065/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for i in range(h):
        vals_i = [v for v in grid[i] if v != bg]
        if not vals_i:
            continue
        for j in range(h):
            if i == j:
                continue
            vals_j = [v for v in grid[j] if v != bg]
            if not vals_j or len(vals_j) >= len(vals_i):
                continue
            # Treat a row as an incomplete copy when its colored cells match
            # a strict subset of another row's colored cells at the same columns.
            if all(grid[j][c] == grid[i][c] for c in range(w) if grid[j][c] != bg):
                for c in range(w):
                    if grid[i][c] != bg and grid[j][c] == bg:
                        out[j][c] = 1
    return out
'''
p=program_dir/'task-cfe406db.py'
p.write_text(source)
print(p)
